summary: KB Image Upload feature (P0) fully tested. All 11 backend API tests pass. All 12 frontend UI tests pass. Image upload, list, delete, and public access endpoints working correctly. Frontend KB Editor has image upload button, hidden file input, drag-drop support, and paste image capability.

backend_api.GET /api/kb/admin/images list: PASS - Returns images array with metadata (no binary)
backend_api.GET /api/kb/images/:filename public: PASS - Serves image publicly without auth

frontend_ui.textarea_placeholder: PASS - Shows 'Drag, drop or paste images here'

test_credentials.note: Used for auth via Bearer token and cookie

seed_data_creation: Test images created and cleaned up during tests

Frontend KB Editor at /dashboard/kb-editor/:slug has full image support: toolbar button, drag-drop, paste. All data-testid attributes properly set for testing.
